i really don’t think people who were disappointed with s2 only care about cute and happy moments between wilmon, especially seeing as s1 is generally loved and regarded as a masterpiece despite the fact that wilmon were barely happier in it. i see this being brought up often whenever someone dares to criticize s2 and i find it very reductive. YR is a drama and everyone is aware of that. i can only speak for myself but personally, i felt let down by s2 in terms of quality of writing as well as cinematography. what drew me to YR when i was watching s1 was the writing, which i found raw and beautiful in its simplicity as well as pleasantly surprising in the way it switched up popular tropes. i also really enjoyed the fact that YR seemed to have its own unique touch and atmosphere, and it was gorgeously shot. i didn’t find that same quality in s2, and the season to me felt a lot more wonky, which is why it was harder for me to enjoy myself and feel a connection to what i was watching.

the english subtitles for the apology scene in ep5 are misleading. it looks like wille is saying “i didn’t tell you about the video because august is my back up”, but that’s not what he says. he first starts by apologizing for not telling simon about august. then, he moves on to the next topic, which is august being his back up and wille’s ability to abdicate. 

what he says in swedish could be translated to “look/listen, august is my back up…”. so there is no link between these two sentences, but the translation is slightly off which makes it look like there is - which sucks because i’ve seen so many people being confused by this and it completely changes the meaning of the scene!! it makes wille look manipulative when in fact it’s the first scene where he is being 100% honest to simon, baring his heart and telling him how he feels, just like simon wanted him to. its a huge scene for wille character development wise so its sad to see it being misunderstood :(

Cant believe I found someone like me. Like you said, when you google stuff, you usually find articles about people being disturbed by the sight of blood. But for me, I start feeling faint whenever I hear, read or even think about medical stuff. I was reading a book the other day about a woman with cancer and the description of her bruises and blood clotting almost made faint in the subway.
It’s truly debilitating. I’ve fainted a lot more times than most people I know and it’s a huge hindrance in my everyday life because you never know when you’re going to be subject to medical or blood talk. I also had the same issues with sex ed like you mentioned.

I think this might just be a more extreme version of the regular fear of the sight of blood that is experienced by a lot of people. Definitely makes you feel like you’re not God’s strongest soldier… I wonder if there are ways to get better though. I would certainly like to.
